answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 37453 Country: India Title: In my dream I was there with others, on the sky one white horse with wings (buraq) standing Question: In my dream I was there with others, on the sky one white horse with wings (buraq) standing. One lady wearing yellow colour shiny dress, cap, bindi on forehead, she is trying to sit on buraq, One knife came and cut her in two pieces, my neighbour told me after this the holy Prophet Muhammad (SAW) will appear, search for him. We all are searching for him. I ask how to recognize the holy Prophet Muhammad (SAW). She said if we see, we will come to know then we went one small street saw one old door and slowly somebody was coming and I saw and told to my neighbour he is NABI SAW he is having beard, shining face, wearing white clothes and cap, I rushed and hold his right hand with my two hands then NABI SAW looked at me with a pleasant smile then my neighbor also did the same. I called my daughter she did not come; instead my neighbor's daughter came and holds his hand. Then NABI SAW without saying anything he sign with his hand gently, to go. Then he went off by looking at me with a smile. I did sajdah and thanked Allah for showing NABI. Please explain. Answer ID: 37453 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 538/L=275/TL=1433) Ma-shaAllah, it is a blessed dream. In-shaAllah, you shall attain high status if you follow sunnah and recite durood extensively. However you should avoid the worldly pleasures and showy dresses etc for the same. The woman that was visible in shiny dress it was the world, after she was killed you were bestowed with the ziyarah of the holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم). The holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم), his Sahaba and Sahabiyat passed very simple life, we should also follow the same. Also it is necessary for you to guard your daughter and make her habitual of the said things. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
